154.subject: biology
154.subtopic: Human reproduction — embryonic developmental milestones (gestational weeks)
154.concept: First movement & hair on head → ~20 weeks; eyelashes by ~24 wks; full term → ~38–40 wks.

155.subject: biology
155.subtopic: Population interactions — sexual deceit (orchid – wasp mimicry)
155.concept: Mediterranean orchid Ophrys mimics female bee/wasp to attract males for pollination — pseudo-copulation → sexual deceit.

156.subject: biology
156.concept: Identify the option containing only bony fishes (e.g., Catla, Labeo, sea horse); exclude Chondrichthyes / non-fish.

157.subject: biology
157.subtopic: Biological evolution — geological timeline of life
157.concept: 65 mya → K-Pg extinction (dinosaurs); 500 mya → invertebrate radiation; 200 mya → mammals appear; etc.

158.subject: biology
158.subtopic: Sex determination / gametogenesis — haploid gametes by mitosis (honeybee drones)
158.concept: Drones are haploid (parthenogenetic) and produce sperm by mitotic divisions, not meiosis.

159.subject: biology
159.subtopic: Body fluids and circulation — differential WBC count
159.concept: Given 8000 WBC/mm³ with eosinophils ~1–6% and lymphocytes ~20–45%, compute approximate counts.

160.subject: biology
160.subtopic: ABO blood group — multiple alleles, Mendelian probability
160.concept: Heterozygous A (IA i) × heterozygous B (IB i) → 1 AB : 1 A : 1 B : 1 O → probability of given offspring blood group.

161.subject: biology
161.concept: Order: ↓BP/GFR → renin from JGA → angiotensin I → II → vasoconstriction + aldosterone → Na⁺/H2O reabsorption.

162.subject: biology
162.subtopic: Population interactions — mutualism, parasitism, amensalism, predation, competition
162.concept: Evaluate statements describing each interaction (mutualism +/+, parasitism +/−, amensalism 0/−, etc.).

163.subject: biology
163.concept: Spermatogonia divide mitotically → primary spermatocyte (2n) → meiosis I → secondary spermatocyte (n) → meiosis II → spermatids.

164.subject: biology
164.concept: Sequence in human host: sporozoites injected by mosquito → liver (exo-erythrocytic) → RBC → trophozoite → schizont → merozoite → gametocytes.

165.subject: biology
165.subtopic: Microbes in human welfare — microbial bioactive molecules
165.concept: Streptokinase → dissolve clots; statins → cholesterol-lowering; cyclosporin A → immunosuppressant; LAB → curd.

166.subject: biology
166.subtopic: Evolution — convergent vs divergent (homologous vs analogous structures)
166.concept: Whale and bat forelimbs are homologous (divergent evolution) — NOT an example of convergent evolution.

167.subject: biology
167.subtopic: Microbes in food processing — Swiss cheese
167.concept: Propionibacterium sharmanii ferments lactic acid producing CO2 → large holes in Swiss cheese.

168.subject: biology
168.concept: Cortisol → anti-inflammatory / stress response; aldosterone → Na⁺ and water reabsorption from renal tubules.

169.subject: biology
169.subtopic: Human reproduction — layers around the ovum
169.concept: Outer → inner: corona radiata → zona pellucida → plasma membrane of the egg.

170.subject: biology
170.concept: dN/dt = rN × (K − N)/K, where K is the carrying capacity (sigmoid curve).

171.subject: biology
171.subtopic: Applications in agriculture — Bt crops, Cry proteins
171.concept: cryIAc → cotton bollworms; cryIIAb → corn borer; cryIAb similar; specific Cry proteins target specific insect orders.

172.subject: biology
172.concept: JGA components: macula densa (DCT) + juxtaglomerular cells (afferent arteriole) + extraglomerular mesangial cells.

173.subject: biology
173.subtopic: Respiration — modes of breathing across animals
173.concept: Molluscs → branchial (gills); Reptiles → pulmonary only; Adult amphibians → pulmonary + cutaneous; Amoeba → cellular / by diffusion.

174.subject: biology
174.subtopic: Genetic code — sickle-cell anaemia mutant codon
174.concept: Normal codon GAG (Glu) → mutant GUG (Val) at the 6th position of β-globin → HbS → polymerisation and sickling.

175.subject: biology
175.concept: Female grasshopper = XX (2n + 2 chromosomes); male = XO (2n + 1) — one fewer chromosome than the female.

176.subject: biology
176.subtopic: Animal kingdom — characteristic features (Platyhelminthes, Echinodermata, etc.)
176.concept: Platyhelminthes → incomplete digestive system (true); adult echinoderms → radial symmetry (so claim of bilateral is false).

177.subject: biology
177.concept: Reaction cleaves C–C bond, forms C=C without hydrolysis / oxidation → enzyme is a LYASE.

178.subject: biology
178.concept: Pyramid of energy is always upright; biomass / number pyramids can be inverted (e.g., parasite trees, marine ecosystems).

179.subject: biology
179.concept: Ramapithecus → Australopithecus → Homo habilis → Homo erectus → Neanderthal → Homo sapiens.

180.subject: biology
180.subtopic: Breathing — respiratory volumes (TV, IRV, ERV, RV)
180.concept: Tidal Volume ≈ 500 mL; IRV ≈ 2500–3000 mL; ERV ≈ 1000–1100 mL; Residual Volume ≈ 1100–1200 mL.
